summary: Climber fell several hundred feet from the summit ridge down the near-vertical east face of Pico Aislado; fatal
location: Pico Aislado, Sangre de Cristos southeast of Crestone
responding_agency: Saguache County SAR + Alamosa Volunteer SAR + others
notes: Body recovered June 21 by Alpine Rescue Team and Saguache SAR via helicopter
